sql_query: SELECT c.name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= date('now', 'start of month') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
aciklama: Completed order revenue by customer for the current month

sql_query: SELECT p.category, p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(i.line_total), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(i.qty), 2) AS qty FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
aciklama: Completed sales revenue and quantity by product

SELECT p.sku, p.name AS product, p.category, w.name AS warehouse, inv.qty FROM inventory inv JOIN products p ON p.id = inv.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = inv.warehouse_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND inv.qty < 20 ORDER BY inv.qty ASC, p.name
aciklama: Active products with warehouse qty below 20
